top_signals.title: GE to Buy Consolidated Precision Products for $11.75B
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Kiel Porter joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." GE Aerospace agreed to buy castings manufacturer Consolidated Precision Products from Warburg Pincus and Berkshire Partners for $11.75 billion, a deal that will significantly expand the jet-engine manufacturer’s capacity for the critical components. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Mengqi Sun joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." A significant shareholder in Xerox is pushing the company to take action to unlock shareholder value and is asking for a strategic review of its financial services business. (Source: Bloomberg)
